_doc: Adaptive-span variant of config.json — Method C from docs/tutorial/SESSION3_MESH_GENERATION.md. Identical physics / BCs / WK auto-calculator; only the mesh block changes. Invoke with: python run_patient.py ubend --config cases_input/ubend/config_adaptive_span.json

mesh._doc: Method C: adaptive_span strategy targets a number of cells across the LOCAL lumen at each region of the mesh. snappy chooses background cell size + insideSpan refinement level via plan_span_background() to hit the target. surfaceRefinementLevels are orthogonal (near-wall only).

geometry._doc: reference_radius_strategy='max' (default) anchors the background-mesh sizing to the largest vessel. For a single-tube ubend the diameter is roughly uniform (27.4 mm inlet, 24.4 mm outlet), so 'max' / 'min' / 'mean' all give similar results. For a multi-branch aorta you'd typically use 'max' for whole-vessel work or 'min' to guarantee resolution in the smallest branch.

windkessel_settings._doc: Auto-calculate mode — same as config.json. wk_setup.py derives Z/C/R from systolic/diastolic targets + inlet flow (CSV) + outlet geometry (Murray's law) + default PWV formula.
